svg.title: Web App VAPT: Black-box + grey-box testing of a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
svg.desc: Web App VAPT. Black-box + grey-box testing of a multi-tenant SaaS platform. Offense: authN flaws, access-control gaps, SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR. Defense: PoC evidence + CVSS-scored remediation report. Tools: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, SQLMap, Nikto.

g.text: Black-box + grey-box testing of a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
OFFENSE › authN flaws, access-control gaps, SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR
DEFENSE › PoC evidence + CVSS-scored remediation report
